Hi Im Massage Matter of Fact (MMOF), and Im a Remedial trained massage therapist and long time Registered Nurse.
I practice RM, relaxation, pregnancy massage, deep tissue and reflexology and incorporate other modalities such as cupping, hot and cold rock and basic taping.
Hope some of my vids can be of help to you all.
